profile.headline: Creative Frontend Developer · Interactive Developer · JavaScript, HTML/CSS, GSAP · Interactive UI, Animation & Accessible Web Experiences
profile.summary:
I’m a Creative Frontend Developer with 7+ years of experience building interactive, animation-driven web experiences and a strong foundation in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I enjoy the space where design and engineering meet—translating visual ideas into responsive, performant, and accessible interfaces.

At Yahoo, I developed production-ready interactive advertising experiences and reusable creative systems supporting Yahoo DSP workflows. My work included animation with GSAP, configurable templates, dynamic and data-driven experiences, API and platform SDK integrations, and frontend development under strict performance, file-size, and cross-platform constraints. Across 145 creative builds, my work supported $117.6K in creative fees and $3M in direct media revenue.

More recently, I’ve expanded that work beyond advertising through independent creative frontend development. For Carmen Cruz Coaching, I took a small-business website from visual direction and requirements through custom frontend implementation and accessibility remediation, working across responsive UI, interactive components, WordPress/PHP, JavaScript, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility.

I’m continuing to deepen my modern frontend engineering skills through React, TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, and the TanStack ecosystem while building projects that combine stronger application architecture with the interactive and visual work I’ve spent my career developing.

I’m especially interested in Creative Frontend Engineer, Design Developer, Interactive Developer, and Creative Technologist roles where frontend engineering, interaction, animation, and thoughtful design implementation come together.

positions.title: Creative Frontend Developer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description:
Independent creative frontend development focused on translating visual direction and business requirements into responsive, accessible web experiences.

Carmen Cruz Coaching — Website Design & Development
• Led the end-to-end development of a production website for a new coaching business, from platform and theme selection through visual iteration, frontend implementation, launch, and ongoing improvements.
• Collaborated directly with stakeholders to translate brand materials, content needs, and design references into custom responsive page layouts and interactive UI, extending a WordPress child theme with PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
• Built reusable and content-driven functionality, including a custom testimonial content type and carousel, service experiences, FAQ accordions, and a contact workflow with reCAPTCHA.
• Conducted a component-by-component WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility audit using browser DevTools, keyboard navigation, and VoiceOver, then remediated issues across semantic structure, focus behavior, forms, imagery, target sizing, and color contrast.
• Rebuilt visual content containing essential text as semantic HTML and CSS, preserving the intended design while improving accessibility and responsive behavior.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · JavaScript · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Responsive Web Design · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) · WordPress · PHP

positions.title: Interactive Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Ad Tech · Interactive Creative Development
• Developed scalable interactive ad experiences and reusable creative systems using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and GSAP under strict performance, file-size, and cross-platform delivery constraints.
• Translated creative concepts and campaign requirements into polished interactive experiences, collaborating with designers, product partners, and stakeholders across production workflows supporting Yahoo DSP and ad-serving platforms.
• Built configurable creative templates and reusable interaction patterns—including game-based and modular experiences—to reduce repetitive development and support faster production across campaigns.
• Integrated dynamic, data-driven content and interactive functionality using ad-serving SDKs, platform capabilities, and third-party APIs.
• Optimized animation, media assets, and frontend execution for performance, reliability, and smooth playback across devices and advertising environments.
• Contributed reusable templates, tooling, and frontend patterns to internal repositories, helping standardize creative production and enable broader team reuse.
• Delivered 145 creative builds across 35 creative projects and 30 advertisers, supporting $117.6K in creative fees and $3M in direct media revenue.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · GSAP · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Front-End Development · Git · Interactive Media · JSON · Adobe Creative Suite · Adobe Photoshop

projects.title: Carmen Cruz Coaching — Website Design & Development
projects.description:
Designed and developed a responsive website for Carmen Cruz Coaching, translating stakeholder input, existing brand materials, and business requirements into a customized web experience for a new coaching business.

Built and extended a WordPress child theme using PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, creating custom page layouts and interactive components including a content-managed testimonial carousel, service experiences, FAQ accordions, and a contact workflow with reCAPTCHA.

Conducted a component-by-component WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility audit using browser DevTools, keyboard testing, and VoiceOver, and implemented remediations across semantic structure, focus behavior, forms, imagery, target sizing, and color contrast.

projects.title: Integrated Media Arts - MFA program's website
projects.description:
Developed and launched a redesigned website for Hunter College’s Integrated Media Arts MFA program, collaborating with program leadership to translate content and communication needs into a new web experience.

Customized a WordPress theme using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP; developed custom page layouts and post types; implemented new site functionality; and created or edited visual assets using Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.

Owned the implementation independently with minimal supervision and delivered the site for its January 2018 launch.
